searchText: <@534934855113506836> you may verify a random portion of downloaded blocks. It would give you desired speed boost and still preserve your node from being synced with bad chain. There is a long way to the head, you probably don't want to realize that you've been syncing with wrong chain only after the finish. The calls about surround vote detection approaches have been productive, I wrote up a new improved algo to do the surround detection with. See https://github.com/protolambda/eth2-surround#min-max-surround
